fit_and_evaluation.historical_fit: fit each predeclared tied-readout arm only on exact R47 transfer/third/fourth/fifth examples using the fixed R50 state former; ridge penalty remains 1.0 on non-intercept fitted groups
fit_and_evaluation.attribution_context_reuse: exact R49 sealed contexts reused only to explain the already-observed R49 negative; no fresh generalization claim

frozen_evaluation.supported: valid; exactly one lower-capacity tied-readout arm improves aggregate pairwise winner accuracy over full-6 by >=0.05, improves on >=2/3 attribution contexts, has mean regret <= full-6, and exceeds the second-best lower-capacity arm by >=0.015 accuracy
frozen_evaluation.mixed: valid; support false; best lower-capacity arm improves aggregate accuracy by >=0.015 with >=2/3 positive contexts and mean regret <= full-6, or multiple lower-capacity arms reach >=0.05 without the 0.015 uniqueness margin
frozen_evaluation.negative: valid and neither supported nor mixed

successor_policy.negative: advance representation/readout coupling diagnosis without capacity growth
